text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The academy was abuzz with talk regarding
"a certain pose" Symboli Rudolf had shown
after her victory...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, did you see the president's pose?
The one where she holds up a single index finger!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was so cool!
It just looks so dignified when the president does it~.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what it means?
Like, "I won!" or something?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
No way. This is the president we're talking about, right?
It's bound to have a much deeper, noble meaning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A pose garnering so much attention from the students.
What in the world could it truly signify...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The meaning behind the president's pose?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it is obviously absolute proof
that she alone stands at the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, her pose, you say...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe it's Rudolf's own way
of striking a totally groovy victory pose?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A pose...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't know. Don't care. Beat it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You mean that pose, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's super cool! Hop!
I imitate it and do it myself sometimes~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I asked several people close to Symboli Rudolf,
but was unable to get a definitive answer...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm, so here you are.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You must be the trainer who has been
going around asking questions about me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hear you have a question for me,
what is it you wish to know?
choice_data_list: About the meaning of that pose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that...
If I had to put it into words—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—it is a "signpost." Both the culmination of
the path I have walked, and the guiding compass for the road ahead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though originally, when winning a certain race,
it started merely as raising a finger for "first victory, checked"...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, however, I do it with deliberate intention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm. What do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Any opinion is fine.
Let me hear your thoughts.
choice_data_list: A declaration that you'll take 1st place next time too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oho, I see that is your answer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, wouldn't that make me appear
rather full of myself?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Pondering deeply is a fine thing.
One must always weigh a thousand considerations!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if the answer you arrive at turns out to be mistaken,
the time spent in contemplation is never wasted!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, if you will excuse me.
If you reach any new conclusions, do share them with me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Perish the thought. I certainly know how to read the room.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hm.
Still, a pun derived from that pose, is it...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It might prove amusing to brainstorm one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For the raw gems of humor often lie
in the most unexpected of places...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A poised pose... No, that lacks punch.
I shall have to refine it further...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf walked away with an intensely
serious expression on her face.
